edges.mechanism: Ashwagandha raises T3/T4 and lowers TSH in subclinical hypothyroidism and modestly raises T4 in pooled RCTs; additive effect with levothyroxine possible.
edges.evidence: RCT (n=50) plus MA of 23 RCTs; no direct interaction study; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Thyroid-hormone-raising effect; case of painless thyroiditis/thyrotoxicosis resolving on withdrawal; reviews cite thyrotoxicosis risk.
edges.evidence: Case report, RCT and reviews; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Idiosyncratic cholestatic/mixed herb-induced liver injury; in pre-existing chronic liver disease it precipitated acute-on-chronic liver failure with deaths. BfR and TGA advise avoidance.
edges.evidence: Case series (DILIN/Iceland, India), scoping review of 25 patients, regulator advice

edges.mechanism: Regulators (Danish DVFA/DTU, German BfR, Australian TGA label warning) cite possible abortifacient/reproductive effects; human harm evidence weak and one small open-label trial reported no AEs.
edges.evidence: Regulatory assessments; systematic review judges teratogenic evidence inconclusive; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: German BfR advises breastfeeding women to avoid ashwagandha supplements because safety data are lacking.
edges.evidence: Regulatory precaution only; no human data

edges.mechanism: Immunostimulatory activity (TLR activation, NF-kB, pro-inflammatory cytokines) may trigger or flare autoimmune disease.
edges.evidence: Scoping review of mostly in vitro/animal plus some human data; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Immunostimulatory properties could theoretically counteract immunosuppressive therapy.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic inference only; no clinical interaction study

edges.mechanism: GABA-modulating and sleep-promoting effects may add to benzodiazepines, hypnotics and other CNS depressants.
edges.evidence: Preclinical GABA data plus sleep RCT meta-analysis; interaction not studied directly

edges.mechanism: Adverse events reported with Withania plus sertraline, escitalopram, paroxetine and reboxetine; proposed CYP/P-gp inhibition and pharmacodynamic overlap.
edges.evidence: Pharmacovigilance retrospective chart review; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Small reduction in fasting glucose may add to glucose-lowering drugs.
edges.evidence: MA of 11 RCTs, FBG -3.09 mg/dL; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Favorable blood-pressure trends in hypertensive patients; possible additive effect.
edges.evidence: Single small RCT (n=60); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Combining with other hepatotoxins adds exposure to idiosyncratic liver injury.
edges.evidence: Case series and exposure survey; no combination study

edges.mechanism: Ashwagandha raises serum testosterone in men; additive effect with androgen therapy or in hormone-sensitive conditions is unstudied.
edges.evidence: MA of RCTs (testosterone +57 ng/dL in men); clinical relevance unknown

edges.mechanism: Co-implicated in one ashwagandha liver-injury case.
